title: Profile
description: Everything the app knows about the person that is not a goal. Web app storage: localStorage key goa:profile and db doc state/profile (the whole object, written by saveProfile through dbSet). Every field is optional: a brand-new user has an empty object {}. Contains sensitive personal and health data (age, sex, height, weight history, free-text rules and notes that often hold medical details).

name.description: First name. Written by renderAbout (abSave) and finishOnboarding. Trimmed, sliced to 30 characters.

sex.description: Used by calcTargets (BMR constant) and kcalFloor. Empty string means 'Prefer not to say'.

age.description: Years. renderAbout stores null when the input is outside 13-100. Onboarding stores +A.age after validating 13-100.

heightCm.description: Height in centimeters. null when outside 120-230 in the About form.

cuisine.description: What the person usually eats, e.g. 'Mediterranean'. Injected into the Claude food-estimate and plate-photo prompts.

waterL.description: Daily water target in liters. Shown in the 'water' check text. Default when missing: 3.

kcalFloor.description: Lowest daily calories ever allowed. When missing or null, kcalFloor() falls back to 1200 (female), 1500 (male), 1400 (other).

proteinFloor.description: Lowest daily protein in grams. When missing, proteinFloor() uses round(goal.protein * 0.85 / 5) * 5.

jointFriendly.description: Go easy on joints: no running, jumping or floor work. Added to the plan-change prompt rules.

rules.description: Free text, one rule per line, that Claude must always respect (e.g. injuries). Sensitive health data.

equip.description: Training equipment. Set only by finishOnboarding ('homefirst' answer is stored as 'gym' plus goal.homeFirst=true). makePlan defaults to 'gym'.

days.description: Training days per week. Set by finishOnboarding. makePlan clamps to 2-5, default 3.

setupAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when onboarding last finished.

waistDay.description: Weekday for the waist measurement, 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday. Read by waistWeekday(); default 1 (Monday). No UI writes it in r14; only a restored backup or a hand-edited doc can set it. Accepts a numeric string because the code does +w.

notes.description: Personal notes (doctor advice, reasoning). Edited in renderNotes. Sensitive.

history.description: Weigh-ins from before tracking started. Shown as a faded line on the weight chart's Goal range (histW only uses entries with d before the goal start). One entry per date: adding a date replaces the old one.

myFoods.description: Personal food-table entries placed in front of the built-in FOODS table by buildFoodIndex. No UI in r14 writes this; it can only arrive from a backup or a hand-edited doc. Invalid entries are silently skipped.

group.description: Grouping heading. The UI always writes 'My notes'.

title.description: Defaults to 'New note' on creation and 'Note' when saved empty.

body.description: Plain text. A line starting with '- ' renders as a bullet; a blank line starts a new paragraph.

k.description: Match keywords. The longest matching keyword wins across all foods.

per.description: Whether v is per piece or per 100 g.

g.description: Grams of one unit (per='unit') or default serving grams (per='100g').

v.description: [kcal, protein g, carbs g, fat g, fiber g] per unit or per 100 g.
